Waves 1 to 2 feet building to 2 to 4 feet in the afternoon.

upcoming.detailed_text: West wind 10 to 15 knots becoming north 15 to 20 knots in the late evening and overnight. Gusts up to 25 knots. Chance of showers and slight chance of thunderstorms through around midnight. Waves 3 to 4 feet building to 3 to 5 feet early in the morning.
North wind 15 to 20 knots becoming 10 to 20 knots early in the afternoon, then veering northeast 15 to 20 knots late in the afternoon. Gusts up to 25 knots. Sunny. Waves 3 to 5 feet.

Northeast wind 15 to 20 knots easing to 10 to 15 knots late in the evening, then backing north after midnight becoming north 10 to 15 knots early in the morning. Clear. Waves 3 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet early in the morning.
